title: Netflix says it expects FY 2026 ad revenue of ~$2.7B, under its ~$3B forecast, and its Q4 operating margin will be impacted due to costs associated with layoffs (Todd Spangler/Variety)
summary: Todd Spangler / Variety: Netflix says it expects FY 2026 ad revenue of ~$2.7B, under its ~$3B forecast, and its Q4 operating margin will be impacted due to costs associated with layoffs — But the streamer faces an urgent need to refresh its queue: Revenue growth in the period slowed to its lowest rate in three years …
